kb_proposals: The spacelike line is a cheap model that is not tarentin but is globally hyperbolic, strongly causal (both forms), causally open, absolutely minimal, with push-up and a time function: its open diamonds are empty (spacelikeLine_openDiamond, from mathlib's interior_singleton). leNested_tarentin_counterexample puts it together with its ≤-nesting in the timelike line (CausalScaffold.NestedTransfer, T-abs-nested-transfer).

A transfer along a nesting that reads only ≤ (causally convex sets, diamonds, strict increase along ≤_M): state the principal form with ≤ nested at M (∀ x y, C.le ⊤ x y → C'.le ⊤ x y) and give the LeNested.* corollary, the form the ladder's [[transfer]] table cites. A property that reads the interior of diamonds (tarentin) passes to the wider causality, not to the narrower one.
